title: make run should work in headless environments
description: After fixing the golden test headless issue (make-update-golden-headless), `make run` still requires a display because the orchestrator's start_observer_client() in orchestrator.py doesn't pass noWindow or java.awt.headless flags. The observer needs Xvfb or a real display for its JFrame. The fix should auto-detect headless environments and start Xvfb (or wrap with xvfb-run), while still supporting screen recordings for YouTube upload — the recording pipeline (ObserverGamePane.startRecording, xmage.observer.record) must continue to work against the virtual framebuffer. Alternatively, add a --headless flag to the puppeteer CLI that configures Xvfb automatically.
